title: Problem Overview
content:
**Erdős Problem #737: Edge in All Large Cycles**

Let G have chromatic number ℵ₁. Must there exist an edge e in cycles of all large lengths?

**Answer:** YES (Thomassen 1983)

**History:**
- EHS (1974): G contains all large cycles
- Thomassen (1983): Cycles can be routed through one edge
mathContext: Connects uncountable chromatic number to cycle structure in infinite graphs.

title: Chromatic Number and ℵ₁
content:
**chromaticNumber G:** Axiomatized as a cardinal-valued function.

**hasChromaticNumberAleph1 G:** χ(G) = ℵ₁, the first uncountable cardinal.

This is the critical threshold for Thomassen's result. Finite or countable χ doesn't suffice.
mathContext: De Bruijn-Erdős theorem: χ(G) = sup{χ(H) : H finite subgraph}.

title: Cycle and Edge Predicates
content:
**hasCycleOfLength G n:** G contains a cycle of length n (axiomatized).

**edgeInCycleOfLength G u v h n:** Edge (u,v) belongs to a cycle of length n.

**edgeInAllLargeCycles:** Edge is in cycles of all lengths ≥ N.

**existsEdgeInAllLargeCycles:** The main property: ∃ edge in all large cycles.
mathContext: See annotation content for formal details of cycle and edge predicates

title: Erdős-Hajnal-Shelah (1974)
content:
**erdos_hajnal_shelah_1974:** If χ(G) = ℵ₁, then G contains all sufficiently large cycles.

∃ N, ∀ n ≥ N: G has a cycle of length n.

This established cycle existence but not the edge routing property.

title: Thomassen's Theorem (1983)
content:
**thomassen_1983:** If χ(G) = ℵ₁, there exists an edge e such that G contains a cycle of length n through e for all large n.

This is STRONGER than EHS — cycles can be routed through one edge.

**erdos_737_resolved** directly applies Thomassen to resolve Problem #737.

title: Eventually Pancyclic
content:
**eventually_pancyclic:** Graphs with χ = ℵ₁ contain cycles of all sufficiently large lengths.

Follows directly from EHS 1974. This is a weaker form of Thomassen's result.
mathContext: See annotation content for formal details of eventually pancyclic

title: Universal Cycle Edges
content:
**isUniversalCycleEdge:** An edge is "universal" if it lies in all large cycles.

**universal_edges_exist:** Thomassen's theorem guarantees such edges exist when χ = ℵ₁.
mathContext: See annotation content for formal details of universal cycle edges

title: Summary Theorem
content:
**erdos_737_summary:** For χ(G) = ℵ₁, there exists an edge in all large cycles.

Thomassen's theorem as the definitive resolution of Erdős Problem #737.
mathContext: See annotation content for formal details of summary theorem
